name: Conversation Practice
description: Creates guided conversation practice with prompts, scaffolding, and feedback for language learners using the communicative approach. Produces a structured conversation exercise the learner can practice with the AI. Use when a learner asks to practice conversation in a target language, do speaking exercises, practice dialogue, or improve conversational fluency. Do NOT use for grammar instruction (use `grammar-practice`), for vocabulary building (use `vocabulary-building`), or for translation exercises (use `translation-practice`).
